name: Oracle-EBS-SQL
description: Library of Oracle EBS SQLs for operational Excel and ECC reporting, Discoverer replacement, Oracle EBS performance tuning and rapid report development.

paragraphs: 800+ open source Oracle E-Business Suite SQL reports for rapid Excel reporting, financial analysis, and operational monitoring — covering AP, AR, GL, PO, INV, WIP, HR, FA, and more Oracle EBS modules.
Part of the Enginatics Reporting Library and powered by Blitz Report™ — the world's fastest Oracle EBS reporting tool.

Blitz Report™ is built on Oracle EBS forms technology, requiring minimal training. Reports output directly from the database to Excel — no intermediate XML or BI Publisher rendering — so there are no data or performance limits.
